title: От Луки 17 — Luke 17
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.explain: Вера is the subject of спасла (saved), so it stays in the nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: «Всегда будет повод для ___, но горе тому, кто толкает людей на грех».
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) always takes the genitive, so грех becomes греха.

cases.sentence: Скажете ли вы ему, когда он возвратится с ___?
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "from" takes the genitive, so поле becomes поля.

cases.sentence: Он пал к ___ Иисуса и благодарил Его.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always takes the dative, so нога becomes ногам in the plural.
The verb сказать (to say to someone) governs the dative case, so дерево becomes дереву.

cases.sentence: …если бы ему надели на ___ мельничный жернов и бросили в море.
cases.explain: На marking motion onto/around something takes the accusative here, so шея becomes шею.

cases.sentence: «Вырвись с ___ и пересади себя в море», и оно вам подчинится.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "together with" takes the instrumental, so корень becomes корнем.

cases.sentence: …а его вещи в ___, пусть он не спускается вниз за вещами.
cases.explain: The preposition в marking location (no motion) takes the prepositional, so дом becomes доме.

reading.ru: Для того, кто хотя бы одному из этих малых даст повод ко греху, было бы лучше, если бы ему надели на шею мельничный жернов и бросили в море.
reading.question: What did Jesus say would be better than causing one of the little ones to sin?
options: Having a millstone hung around your neck and being thrown into the sea
reading.correct: Having a millstone hung around your neck and being thrown into the sea
reading.explain: Jesus said it would be better for such a person to have a millstone hung around his neck and be thrown into the sea.

reading.ru: Если даже он согрешит против тебя семь раз в день и семь раз придет к тебе и скажет, я каюсь, прости его.
reading.question: According to Jesus, how many times should you forgive your brother if he repents each time?
options: Seventy times seven, but never more
reading.explain: Jesus said that even if your brother sins against you seven times a day and repents each time, you must forgive him.

reading.ru: Господь ответил, если у вас есть вера с горчичное зерно, то вы можете сказать этому тутовому дереву.
reading.question: What did Jesus compare the amount of faith needed to a mulberry tree to?
reading.explain: The Lord answered that if they had faith like a grain of mustard seed, they could command the mulberry tree to be uprooted and planted in the sea.

reading.ru: Так и вы, когда сделаете все, что вам было приказано, говорите, «Мы недостойные слуги, мы сделали лишь то, что обязаны были сделать».
reading.question: What are servants supposed to say after doing everything they were commanded to do?
options: "We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty"
"We are the best of all servants"
reading.correct: "We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty"
reading.explain: Jesus taught that after doing all they were commanded, servants should say they are unworthy servants who only did their duty.

reading.ru: Он пал к ногам Иисуса и благодарил Его, и этот человек был самарянином.
reading.question: Of the ten lepers healed, who returned to thank Jesus, and what was he?
options: A Pharisee who witnessed the healing
reading.explain: Only one of the ten healed lepers came back praising God, fell at Jesus' feet, and he was a Samaritan.

reading.ru: Он ответил, «Божье Царство не придет зримым образом. Никто не сможет сказать, вот оно здесь или оно там, потому что Божье Царство среди вас».
reading.question: How did Jesus answer the Pharisees who asked when God's Kingdom would come?
options: It does not come with visible signs, for it is already among you
It will come with an army and visible conquest
It will come only after Rome falls
It will come on an announced future date
reading.correct: It does not come with visible signs, for it is already among you
reading.explain: Jesus said God's Kingdom does not come with observation, and no one can point to it, because it is already among them.

reading.ru: Но как было во дни Ноя, так будет и во дни Сына Человеческого.
reading.question: To what past event did Jesus compare the coming of the Son of Man?
reading.explain: Jesus said the day of the Son of Man's coming would be just as it was in the days of Noah, when people carried on as usual until the flood came.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «Где труп, туда соберутся истервятники».
reading.question: How did Jesus answer the disciples who asked, "Where, Lord?"
options: "Where the body is, there the vultures will gather"
reading.correct: "Where the body is, there the vultures will gather"
reading.explain: When the disciples asked where this would happen, Jesus answered that where the body is, there the vultures gather — the ending saying of the chapter.
